description: This file defines a custom exception class `BusinessDateNotFoundException` used in the Fineract project to signal that a business date was not found. It extends `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException` and provides static methods to create instances with specific error messages.

classes.name: BusinessDateNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception thrown when a business date is not found in the system. Provides constructors and static factory methods for specific 'not exist' and 'not found' cases.

methods.name: BusinessDateNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with specific error codes and messages.

methods.name: notExist
methods.description: Static factory method to create an exception indicating a business date of a specific type does not exist.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Static factory method to create an exception indicating a business date of a specific type was not found.
